name: Project Apollo Data Centre Macquarie Park

postcode.note: suburb postcode (Australia Post); not stated in source

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 4 Talavera Road (site is 4-10)

builder.note: no head contractor announced as at 2026-09-27

mw_it.note: IT load not stated in the Assessment Report or EIS; both give total power only

mw_grid.note: 'Total power consumption of up to 135 megawatts (MW)' (Assessment Report Table 1); EIS describes a '135MVA data centre'. Portal description: 'initial load capacity of approximately 90MVA'; DCCEEW's earlier BDAR waiver was for 'up to 90 MW power consumption'

cost_aud_m.note: Estimated development cost $1,365,463,075 (Assessment Report Table 1 and conclusion); media rounded to $1.36bn/$1.365bn/$1.37bn

authority.note: Minister for Planning and Public Spaces is consent authority; determined by the A/Director, Industry Assessments under delegation executed 18 Aug 2026

lodged.note: approximate: EIS (Urbis, Feb 2025) uploaded to the major projects portal 10 Mar 2025; exhibited 21 Mar-17 Apr 2025

determined.note: Determination Date 02/09/2026 on the planning portal; decider: Director

jobs_construction.note: EIS (Linesight estimate): 'the development is estimated to generate 400 full-time equivalent jobs consistently throughout the lifetime of development build' ('based on the direct employment impact'); construction up to ~24 months. Assessment Report: '400 full-time equivalent construction jobs'. Tagged average because the source describes a constant FTE level over the build, not a peak

jobs_operational.note: EIS: engineering operations 34 staff (15 per shift x 2 shifts + 4 managers) + data centre operations 26 staff = 'total number of operational jobs for the proposal is 60 jobs'; Assessment Report: '60 operational jobs'

open_questions: mw: IT load not stated in planning documents; 135MW is total power (initial ~90MVA)
